POST /v1/folders/{id}/files.description: Files are encrypted on the device with a key of their own; the name, type and that key are sealed for the folder's members and sent as `envelope`. This registers the file; the content follows with PUT /v1/files/{id}/content. `{id}` is the conversation (folder, forum, chat, wall, ticket, project or event) the file belongs to.

request.id: uuid, required. UUID v7 chosen by the uploader
request.epoch: integer, required. Key generation of the folder
request.envelope: base64, required. Sealed name, type and file key

response.folder: uuid. The container it is in (folder, forum, private chat, wall, ticket, project or event)
response.epoch: integer. Key generation of the folder's key
response.envelope: base64. The file's name, type and its own key, sealed for the folder's members
response.size: integer. Bytes of ciphertext once uploaded

errors.400: Not a valid envelope, bad id, files cannot be attached to that kind of conversation
errors.409: epoch_changed: the folder key changed, fetch it and retry
errors.413: quota_exceeded: over the person's storage limit; too_large: over the maximum file size

PUT /v1/files/{id}/content.description: Send the ciphertext as the raw request body (`Content-Type: application/octet-stream`) with `Content-Length`. The server stores it without being able to read it. Only the uploader, once, before the file is ready.
PUT /v1/files/{id}/content.access: the person who started the upload

response.folder: uuid. The container it is in (folder, forum, private chat, wall, ticket, project or event)
response.epoch: integer. Key generation of the folder's key
response.envelope: base64. The file's name, type and its own key, sealed for the folder's members
response.size: integer. Bytes of ciphertext once uploaded

errors.413: too_large: larger than allowed or larger than announced; quota_exceeded

GET /v1/files/{id}/content.description: Returns the ciphertext (supports range requests). Decrypt on the device with the file key from the sealed envelope.
GET /v1/files/{id}/content.access: a member of the container the file is in, with Files: View

GET /v1/folders/{id}/files.access: a role with Files: View, and membership of the container

files.folder: uuid. The container it is in (folder, forum, private chat, wall, ticket, project or event)
files.epoch: integer. Key generation of the folder's key
files.envelope: base64. The file's name, type and its own key, sealed for the folder's members
files.size: integer. Bytes of ciphertext once uploaded

DELETE /v1/files/{id}.access: the uploader (Delete own files) or a role with Files: Delete

POST /v1/files/{id}/shares.summary: Create a link to share a file outside Hub
POST /v1/files/{id}/shares.description: The link works without signing in. The file key is wrapped with a key that lives only in the link (after the `#`), so the server cannot open what it serves. A link lasts 1 hour to 30 days, up to 1000 downloads, optionally with a password. May need approval (flows f3, f6): then `share.status` is pending.
POST /v1/files/{id}/shares.access: a role with Secure share: Create link or Files: Share outside Hub, unless the organization turned sharing off

request.key_envelope: base64, required. The file key wrapped with the link key, made on the device

share.status: string. active | pending approval | revoked | expired
share.token: string. The link token, shown once at creation

response.approval: object. The approval request when one is needed

errors.400: Lifetime, download count or password out of range, or the key package is not valid
errors.403: sharing_off: the organization turned off sharing outside Hub

GET /v1/shares.description: Link history. Tokens are not shown again.
GET /v1/shares.access: a role with Secure share: View link history

shares.status: string. active | pending approval | revoked | expired
shares.token: string. The link token, shown once at creation

DELETE /v1/shares/{id}.access: the creator, or a role with Secure share: View link history

GET /v1/share/{token}.description: What a recipient sees before downloading. Public and rate-limited by address.

response.key_envelope: base64. Present only when there is no password; otherwise it comes from /unlock

errors.404: link_gone: expired, used up or removed

POST /v1/share/{token}/unlock.description: Five wrong passwords per link and address block it for 15 minutes.

response.download_pass: string. Valid for 2 minutes, pass it to /content as `pass`

GET /v1/share/{token}/content.summary: Download a shared file's encrypted bytes
GET /v1/share/{token}/content.description: The recipient decrypts it in the browser with the key after the `#` in the link. Counts one download.

query.pass: string. The `download_pass` from /unlock, for protected links

GET /v1/storage/usage.access: any signed-in member of the organization (token issued with `org`)

response.custom: boolean. true when this person has their own limit

GET /v1/storage/files.access: any signed-in member of the organization (token issued with `org`)

files.kind: string. folder | forum | dm | wall | ticket | project | event

GET /v1/storage/people.description: The people using the most space and everyone with their own limit.
GET /v1/storage/people.access: a role with Settings: Edit organization profile

people.custom: boolean. true when this person has their own limit
people.name: string

PUT /v1/storage/people/{id}.description: Send `quota_mb` null to go back to the organization's default.
PUT /v1/storage/people/{id}.access: a role with Settings: Edit organization profile

request.quota_mb: integer. 0 (no limit) to 10 TB, or null for the default
